description.value: Brewing August bills itself as the only brewery in Kitsilano, operating a relaxed taproom with 10 house taps alongside mead, cocktails, and non-alcoholic options. Burgers are served from an on-site vendor (Between2Buns), and the upstairs section can be booked for private events up to 50 guests. A weekly run club that sets off from the back of the brewery makes this a natural stop for active visitors exploring the Kitsilano neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Brewing August is an active brewery taproom at 1614 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver BC V6J 1K2, matching the OSM address exactly. The site describes 10 taps, an on-site food vendor (Between2Buns), weekly events (trivia, run club), and a patio, confirming the business is open and operational. No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null.
concerns: No phone number available in OSM or on the website.

OSM opening_hours tag differs slightly from hours listed on the website (e.g. OSM shows Mo-We 16:00-22:00 but website shows Monday 2pm-9pm, Wednesday 2pm-10pm); website version preferred as more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active brewery taproom in Kitsilano with confirmed address, current programming, and food service — a useful stop for touring cyclists in the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact email from website: beer@brewingaugust.com. Dogs not permitted inside per Coastal Health rules but welcome on patio.
